instruction: Candid medium shot of a sunny outdoor park with a banner in the background. On the left, the woman in the black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) holds a giant white inflatable bowling pin over her shoulder. In the center, the man in the red polo shirt (R3) swings his inflatable pin downward, while the woman with the large afro in a red t-shirt (R6) stands behind him. On the right, the large man in the dark blue t-shirt (R1) stands with his back to the camera, holding a large black ball. Bright daylight illuminates the scene.
